text:
Get into Google's top 10 and stay there forever?

No.

Google made over 4,700 changes to its search in one year. Your competitors keep working too.

A ranking is something you keep earning. Keep the reviews, photos and service pages coming every week.

Roofer in Rockingham hits the top 3 on Google's map in March.

Stops asking for reviews. (He's earned a rest.)

By October, a newer roofer who asks for a review after every job sits in his spot.

Getting to the top takes work. Staying there takes work every week.

Someone taps Call on your Google map listing.

Google charges you nothing for that call.

Your ads stop the day you stop paying. Your map spot keeps working while you're up a ladder.

Ads bring calls this week. The map brings free calls once you've earned your spot. Run both.
